$comment: Constructed from HL7 FHIR R5 Observation concepts; see ../provenance.json.

clin_eff_ts.description: Physiologically relevant date and time when the observed value was true.

enc_ref.description: Reference to the healthcare encounter associated with the observation.

final_ind.description: True when the observation result has reached final status.

issued_ts.description: Date and time this version of the result was made available to providers.

loinc_cd.description: Coded measurement or assertion represented by this observation.

obs_uid.description: Business identifier assigned to the clinical observation.

performer_ref.description: Reference to the person or organization responsible for asserting the result.

pt_ref.description: Reference to the patient or other subject whose measurement this is.

result_num.description: Numeric quantity asserted by the observation.

ucum_cd.description: Unit code accompanying the measured quantity.
